All 4 active tests pass.

Green Phase Complete:
- **Implementation**: `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-25_23-41-36_game-of-life-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking-2/src/game-of-life.ts` — added an `isNeighbor` helper (Chebyshev distance <= 1, excluding the cell itself) and changed `nextGeneration` to filter living cells down to those with exactly 3 living neighbors.
- **Result**: All tests now pass (4 passing, 5 todo).
- **Approach**: This is minimal because the only survival case any active test demands is "exactly 3 neighbors". The three earlier tests (empty grid, single cell, two adjacent cells) all yield cells with 0 or 1 neighbors, so `=== 3` keeps them empty without any extra branching. No birth rule, no `2 || 3` survival rule, no neighbor-count generalization was added — those wait for the tests that demand them. The current test uses `toContainEqual`, so no work was done to control which other cells appear in the result.
